owner_approval_text: Approve the evidence-preserving A6-A8 retrieval-focused extension: A6 materializes the frozen ARM-03 retrieval pool over full DAPFAM; A7 performs the seven-layer retrieval diagnosis and comparison framework; A8 synthesizes the validated evidence into the journal manuscript and submission package.

A6.role: full retrieval materialization, operational scalability, and immutable evidence creation

A7.role: seven-layer retrieval diagnosis and comparison framework
A7.compute_policy: CPU_FIRST; optional A7-L3R fixed-reference reproduction only with fresh GPU admission

A8.role: journal synthesis, literature audit, figures, tables, manuscript, and submission package

global_invariants: A0-A5 receipts, hashes, Selection, and Final evidence remain immutable predecessor evidence.
A6 uses exactly one A5-frozen ARM-03 configuration and cannot tune, reselect, or reopen Selection or Final.
A6 provider-side inputs and all repository projections remain protected-data safe; raw rankings, qrels, membership, IDs, and per-query outcomes stay in Owner Store.
A7 consumes the immutable A6 frozen diagnostic bundle and cannot expand the pool or introduce a new retrieval winner.
A8 adds no new scientific experiment merely to enlarge the manuscript; all claims trace to A0-A7 evidence.
No reranking phase or additional embedding-model search is part of this amendment.
